propositions: Agentic runs waste 40-70% of request budget repeating identical deterministic tool calls (e.g., search_files called 144x, list_directory looped 62x on '(no matches)').
First and second repeats of an allowlisted read-only call must return cached result without re-executing the tool, with escalating static nudge text to steer the model away from the loop.
Error-prefixed results (transient failures) must NOT be memoized and must re-execute on retry, carrying no nudge, because outcome may differ.
Deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)', '(empty)', '(empty range)' must be memoized and nudged, as they are stable honest answers (core 62x-loop waste case).
The runaway guard (distinct-ratio actuator) must still observe memoized duplicates for trip-wire calculation and abort pathological runs unchanged.
Only allowlisted read-only tools (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) are memoized; write or non-deterministic tools like record_criterion_verdict always execute.
